author: barbasniper
body:
I got banned. The reason stated was "Ban Evasion - Flambr"

Flambr is my brothers account, and because of our dad's nerdiness everyone surfing the interwebs from our network it looks like we have the same IP adress from the outside. I think that's the reason why you would think he used my account. He has Never used my  account! (no one! get’s to use my account except me)

I Love Avicus it has been my first choice when I want to minecraft online for 2 years. Please I already miss my friends (it's only been 10 minutes).

// Jemres

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey there Jemres,

Our server's ipcheck put yours and Flambr's account under the same ip, leading us to think that you (or your brother) were ban evading.

If you would be able to provide some proof that these 2 accounts are owned by different people I will be able to unban you.

Thanks, Spoookeh
